part.text:
All 20 test suites pass, including format-test, core-test, and xchar-test. 

**Fix** (include/fmt/core.h:2239): `specs_setter::on_zero()` now ignores the `'0'` flag entirely when an explicit alignment was already parsed (`parse_align` runs before the zero flag), so `specs_.align` and fill are no longer set. This makes `"{:<06}"` → `-42   ` and `"{:>06}"` → `   -42`, while `"{:06}"` still uses numeric zero-padding.
